draft.reply_body:
Hi Teemu,

We can certainly look at extending your rental for a few more days. Could you confirm your booking reference and how many extra days you need? We'll check the equipment isn't due straight out to another customer and get back to you.

One thing to flag: for the extension to count officially, and to avoid a late fee being charged against the original end date, we need to confirm it in writing once we've checked availability — so please hold off treating it as agreed until you hear back from us.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
